text_block_list.text:
Even when I claimed victory in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen and King-san was 
defeated... she still stood proud for 
fighting with dignity to the very end!

And as if seeing right through my wavering 
heart, she taught me to "take pride in who 
you are"...!

"...Stay true to yourself without fear of 
getting hurt! To hold my head high in that 
same spirit, I've decided to take the 
stage at the Fan Appreciation Festival's 
talk show."

Yes, of course I am scared. But... I have 
someone by my side who tells me that I am 
not alone...!
